subject: Next-phase cadence & acceptance checklist — Aureus Health evaluation
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Miriam Lopez <m.lopez@aureushealth.com>, Diego Ramos <diego.r@aureushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 07 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed evaluation cadence (Aureus)

Thanks for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before kickoff: 

1) Goals & success criteria (what we'll validate during the 4-week evaluation):
- Inference latency at 95th percentile <= 350ms for common workflows (EMR search, summarization)
- Per-token cost target under $0.003/token for batch inference profile
- No PII leakage in model outputs for redacted PHI prompts (we'll run the provided test deck)

2) Proposed schedule (kickoff week starts Aug 16):
- Aug 16 (Mon) — Kickoff (1hr): introductions, access, baseline metrics
- Weekly check-ins — Tuesdays 9am PT (30m) — progress, blockers, metric updates
- Aug 30 (Fri) — Midpoint review (45m): initial acceptance against smoke tests
- Sep 3 (Thu) — Final readout + decision (1hr)

3) Ownership:
- Redwood lead: Soojin (technical coordination + runtime config)
- Redwood CS: Marissa (success criteria, acceptance test orchestration)
- Aureus lead: Miriam (business acceptance & stakeholder signoff)
- Aureus infra: Diego (networking, VPN / VPC peering)

4) Next immediate asks (before Aug 13):
- Aureus: Share sample prompt set + scoring rubric (Miriam)
- Aureus: Confirm list of two test users and a contact for firewall/IP allowlist (Diego)
- Redwood: Send mutual action plan and acceptance checklist (I attached v1)

Attached: Aureus_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

I'll schedule the kickoff for Aug 16 and send calendar invites once I get the test artifacts. If any timing conflicts, flag now and we can adjust.

Best,
Soojin

Thanks Soojin — that looks good. A few clarifications: 

- We'll aim to get the prompt set and rubric to you by EOD Tue Aug 11.
- Diego will follow up with IPs that need to be allowlisted; he prefers a short window on the 16th for networking prep.
- For acceptance, can we add a reliability threshold: 99.5% availability during the 8-hour daytime window (Mon-Fri)?

We'll also loop in procurement for any required paperwork; they asked for the mutual action plan and a simple SOW. I see the MAP attached — thanks.

I'll tentatively accept the Aug 16 kickoff; please send invites and any pre-kickoff checklist items.

Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed evaluation cadence (Aureus)

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Miriam. Yes — we can include the availability SLA in the acceptance criteria. Updated acceptance checklist highlights:
- Latency (95th) <= 350ms
- Cost <= $0.003/token for batch profile
- No PII leakage on redacted prompts (0 critical findings)
- Availability >= 99.5% during 9am–5pm local business hours for the evaluation window

I've attached a PDF with the acceptance checklist for signoff. Also: Marissa will run the smoke tests during week 2; Karthik will be available for quantization/runtime tuning if we need to trade off latency vs. cost.

I'll send the calendar invites for the kickoff + recurring check-ins later today.

Soojin
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Miriam Lopez <m.lopez@aureushealth.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Acceptance tests & scorecard — quick note before kickoff

Hi all — just a short note on how we'll run acceptance tests so expectations are clear: 

- Week 1 (Aug 16–20): Baseline ingestion & connectivity; run smoke suite (connectivity, end-to-end sample flows).
- Week 2 (Aug 23–27): Functional validation using your prompt deck; we'll score outputs against your rubric.
- Week 3 (Aug 30–Sep 3): Stress & cost profiling (simulate peak slices) + any tuned runs.
- Final readout (Sep 3): We'll present a scorecard with pass/fail per criterion and recommended next steps (deploy, adjust config, or extend trial).

Deliverables from Redwood each week: short runbook notes, snapshot of metrics (latency histogram, token counts/costs), and the annotated scoring doc.

Action: Miriam — please confirm the scoring rubric CSV by Aug 11 so Marissa can ingest it into the scorecard.

Thanks — looking forward to kickoff.
Marissa
